title: Lucky: negócio
description: Uso real do Lucky e as metas do music-first. Fonte: Postgres (somente leitura) e eventos do bot no Loki.

list.name: excluidas
list.description: Guildas do operador, de listagem e de teste: nunca contam como uso.

options.content: Metas do music-first (decisão até **20/12/2026**): **WAG ≥ 20** por 3 semanas, **≥ 35%** das guildas novas ouvem música na 1ª hora, **≥ 15%** ainda ativas no dia 8. Guildas do operador, de listagem e de teste não contam. `track_history` guarda só 30 dias e no máximo 100 faixas por guilda, então janelas maiores que 30 dias subcontam plays.

panels.title: WAG (7 dias)
panels.description: Guildas com faixa tocada ou comando nos últimos 7 dias.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT g) AS "Guildas ativas" FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE t >= now() - interval '7 days' AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')

panels.title: Ouviram música na 1ª hora
panels.description: Guildas que entraram nos últimos 28 dias e tocaram uma faixa na primeira hora. Meta: 35%.

targets.rawSql: WITH counted_joins AS ( SELECT g, t FROM ( SELECT "guildDiscordId" AS g, "occurredAt" AS t, lag("occurredAt") OVER (PARTITION BY "guildDiscordId" ORDER BY "occurredAt") AS prev FROM guild_membership_events WHERE kind = 'JOIN' ) j WHERE prev IS NULL OR t - prev > interval '30 days' ), joins AS (SELECT g, t FROM counted_joins WHERE t > now() - interval '28 days'), c AS (SELECT j.t, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" BETWEEN j.t AND j.t + interval '1 hour') AS heard, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" >= j.t + interval '7 days') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM command_events ce WHERE ce."guildId" = j.g AND ce."occurredAt" >= j.t + interval '7 days')) AS d8 FROM joins j WHERE j.g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')) SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE t <= now() - interval '1 hour' AND heard) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE t <= now() - interval '1 hour'), 0), 1) AS "1ª hora (%)" FROM c

panels.title: Ativas no dia 8
panels.description: Guildas que entraram entre 8 e 28 dias atrás e ainda tocaram ou usaram comando a partir do dia 8. Meta: 15%.

targets.rawSql: WITH counted_joins AS ( SELECT g, t FROM ( SELECT "guildDiscordId" AS g, "occurredAt" AS t, lag("occurredAt") OVER (PARTITION BY "guildDiscordId" ORDER BY "occurredAt") AS prev FROM guild_membership_events WHERE kind = 'JOIN' ) j WHERE prev IS NULL OR t - prev > interval '30 days' ), joins AS (SELECT g, t FROM counted_joins WHERE t > now() - interval '28 days'), c AS (SELECT j.t, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" BETWEEN j.t AND j.t + interval '1 hour') AS heard, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" >= j.t + interval '7 days') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM command_events ce WHERE ce."guildId" = j.g AND ce."occurredAt" >= j.t + interval '7 days')) AS d8 FROM joins j WHERE j.g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')) SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE t <= now() - interval '8 days' AND d8) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE t <= now() - interval '8 days'), 0), 1) AS "Dia 8 (%)" FROM c

panels.title: Entraram (período)
panels.description: Entradas contadas: reentrada em até 30 dias conta uma vez (emenda 5 do ADR). Mesma definição de scripts/music-first-gates.sql.

targets.rawSql: WITH counted_joins AS ( SELECT g, t FROM ( SELECT "guildDiscordId" AS g, "occurredAt" AS t, lag("occurredAt") OVER (PARTITION BY "guildDiscordId" ORDER BY "occurredAt") AS prev FROM guild_membership_events WHERE kind = 'JOIN' ) j WHERE prev IS NULL OR t - prev > interval '30 days' ) SELECT count(*) AS "Entradas" FROM counted_joins WHERE $__timeFilter(t) AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')

SELECT count(*) AS "Saídas" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE kind = 'LEAVE' AND $__timeFilter("occurredAt") AND "guildDiscordId" NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')

panels.title: WAG nas semanas da decisão (meta: 20 nas 3)
panels.description: Semanas segunda a domingo que terminam em 29/11, 06/12 e 13/12/2026 (emenda 5 do ADR). Mesma definição de scripts/music-first-gates.sql. Semana não fechada ainda lê baixo.

targets.rawSql: WITH wag_windows AS ( SELECT week_start FROM (VALUES (DATE '2026-11-23'), (DATE '2026-11-30'), (DATE '2026-12-07')) AS v(week_start) ), activity AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', t)::date AS wk, g FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) x WHERE t >= (SELECT min(week_start) FROM wag_windows)) SELECT w.week_start AS "Semana (início)", w.week_start + 6 AS "Semana (fim)", count(DISTINCT a.g) AS "WAG", count(DISTINCT a.g) >= 20 AS "Meta ≥ 20", w.week_start + 7 <= now()::date AS "Fechada" FROM wag_windows w LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.wk = w.week_start AND a.g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') GROUP BY w.week_start ORDER BY w.week_start

panels.title: WAG por semana (últimas 4 semanas)
panels.description: Semana começa na segunda (UTC). A linha tracejada é a meta de 20.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', t) AS time, count(DISTINCT g) AS "Guildas ativas" FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE t >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '3 weeks' AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Guildas novas por semana de entrada (28 dias)

targets.rawSql: WITH counted_joins AS ( SELECT g, t FROM ( SELECT "guildDiscordId" AS g, "occurredAt" AS t, lag("occurredAt") OVER (PARTITION BY "guildDiscordId" ORDER BY "occurredAt") AS prev FROM guild_membership_events WHERE kind = 'JOIN' ) j WHERE prev IS NULL OR t - prev > interval '30 days' ), joins AS (SELECT g, t FROM counted_joins WHERE t > now() - interval '28 days') SELECT date_trunc('week', j.t)::date AS "Semana", count(*) AS "Entraram", count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" BETWEEN j.t AND j.t + interval '1 hour')) AS "Tocaram na 1ª hora", count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g)) AS "Já tocaram" FROM joins j WHERE j.g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Entradas e 1ª hora por origem (28 dias)
panels.description: Origem vem do parâmetro state do OAuth de /add (topgg, discordbotlist, botsgg, meta, landing, unknown). Joins anteriores a #2750 ou sem origem gravada aparecem como 'sem origem' (entraram por outro link ou antes do rastreio). Só entram joins com mais de 1 hora (a 1ª hora ainda não fechou para os mais novos).

targets.rawSql: WITH joins AS (SELECT "guildDiscordId" AS g, min("occurredAt") AS t FROM guild_membership_events WHERE kind = 'JOIN' GROUP BY 1 HAVING min("occurredAt") > now() - interval '28 days' AND min("occurredAt") <= now() - interval '1 hour') SELECT coalesce(s.source, 'sem origem') AS "Origem", count(*) AS "Entraram", count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" BETWEEN j.t AND j.t + interval '1 hour')) AS "Tocaram na 1ª hora" FROM joins j LEFT JOIN guild_join_sources s ON s."guildDiscordId" = j.g WHERE j.g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Funil de ativação por guilda (período)
panels.description: Funil aninhado: guildas distintas entre as entradas contadas do período (mesma base de 'Entraram (período)': reentrada em até 30 dias conta uma vez, guildas excluídas fora). Clicou exige onboarding entregue; 5+ faixas exige a 1ª hora; dia 8 exige 5+ faixas. A etapa 4 conta a 1ª hora de forma independente do clique, então pode passar da etapa 3. Guildas com histórico cortado pelo limite de 100 faixas de track_history (mesma regra h1_trimmed de scripts/music-first-gates.sql) ficam fora das etapas 4 a 6. Etapas 2 e 3 vêm de activation_events, que só existe a partir do deploy desta instrumentação. A etapa 6 só pode valer 7 dias depois da entrada.

targets.rawSql: WITH counted_joins AS ( SELECT g, t FROM ( SELECT "guildDiscordId" AS g, "occurredAt" AS t, lag("occurredAt") OVER (PARTITION BY "guildDiscordId" ORDER BY "occurredAt") AS prev FROM guild_membership_events WHERE kind = 'JOIN' ) j WHERE prev IS NULL OR t - prev > interval '30 days' ), joins AS (SELECT g, t FROM counted_joins WHERE $__timeFilter(t) AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')), f0 AS (SELECT j.g, j.t, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activation_events a WHERE a."guildDiscordId" = j.g AND a.kind = 'onboarding_delivered' AND a."occurredAt" >= j.t - interval '5 minutes') AS delivered, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activation_events a WHERE a."guildDiscordId" = j.g AND a.kind = 'station_click' AND a."occurredAt" >= j.t - interval '5 minutes') AS clicked, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" BETWEEN j.t AND j.t + interval '1 hour') AND NOT (SELECT count(*) >= 100 AND min(th."playedAt") > j.t + interval '1 hour' FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g) AS heard, (SELECT count(*) FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" BETWEEN j.t AND j.t + interval '7 days') >= 5 AS plays5, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" >= j.t + interval '7 days') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM command_events ce WHERE ce."guildId" = j.g AND ce."occurredAt" >= j.t + interval '7 days')) AS d8 FROM joins j), f AS (SELECT g, delivered, delivered AND clicked AS clicked, heard, heard AND plays5 AS plays5, heard AND plays5 AND d8 AS d8 FROM f0) SELECT '1. Entraram' AS "Etapa", count(*) AS "Guildas" FROM f UNION ALL SELECT '2. Onboarding entregue', count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered) FROM f UNION ALL SELECT '3. Clicou na estação', count(*) FILTER (WHERE clicked) FROM f UNION ALL SELECT '4. Tocou na 1ª hora', count(*) FILTER (WHERE heard) FROM f UNION ALL SELECT '5. 5+ faixas em 7 dias', count(*) FILTER (WHERE plays5) FROM f UNION ALL SELECT '6. Ativa no dia 8', count(*) FILTER (WHERE d8) FROM f ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tempo até o primeiro áudio
panels.description: Mediana (p50) e percentil 90 do intervalo entre a entrada contada e a primeira faixa tocada, nas guildas do período que já tocaram algo. Guildas com histórico cortado pelo limite de 100 faixas (h1_trimmed) ficam fora, porque a primeira faixa delas se perdeu. Quem nunca tocou fica fora (veja a etapa 4 do funil).

targets.rawSql: WITH counted_joins AS ( SELECT g, t FROM ( SELECT "guildDiscordId" AS g, "occurredAt" AS t, lag("occurredAt") OVER (PARTITION BY "guildDiscordId" ORDER BY "occurredAt") AS prev FROM guild_membership_events WHERE kind = 'JOIN' ) j WHERE prev IS NULL OR t - prev > interval '30 days' ), joins AS (SELECT g, t FROM counted_joins WHERE $__timeFilter(t) AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')), first_play AS (SELECT j.g, extract(epoch FROM min(th."playedAt") - j.t) AS secs FROM joins j JOIN track_history th ON th."guildId" = j.g AND th."playedAt" >= j.t WHERE NOT (SELECT count(*) >= 100 AND min(th."playedAt") > j.t + interval '1 hour' FROM track_history th WHERE th."guildId" = j.g) GROUP BY j.g, j.t) SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY secs) AS "p50", percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY secs) AS "p90" FROM first_play

SELECT date_trunc('day', "playedAt") AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT "isAutoplay") AS "Pedidas", count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isAutoplay") AS "Autoplay" FROM track_history WHERE $__timeFilter("playedAt") AND "guildId" NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', "playedAt") AS time, count(DISTINCT "guildId") AS "Guildas tocando" FROM track_history WHERE $__timeFilter("playedAt") AND "guildId" NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT command AS "Comando", count(*) AS "Usos", count(DISTINCT "guildId") AS "Guildas", round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "latencyMs")) AS "Resposta p50 (ms)" FROM command_events WHERE $__timeFilter("occurredAt") AND coalesce("guildId", '') NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Entradas e saídas de servidores por dia

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', "occurredAt") AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'JOIN') AS "Entraram", -count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'LEAVE') AS "Saíram" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE $__timeFilter("occurredAt") AND "guildDiscordId" NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Faixas que vieram do autoplay
panels.description: Inflado: o autoplay grava uma linha ao enfileirar e outra ao tocar (#2667).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isAutoplay") / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Autoplay (%)" FROM track_history WHERE $__timeFilter("playedAt") AND "guildId" NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isAccepted") / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isAccepted" OR "isRejected"), 0), 1) AS "Aceite (%)" FROM recommendations WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")

SELECT coalesce(source::text, 'sem fonte') AS "Fonte", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isAccepted") / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isAccepted" OR "isRejected"), 0), 1) AS "Aceite (%)" FROM recommendations WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.title: Votos no top.gg (30 dias)
panels.description: Pessoas cujo último voto foi nos últimos 30 dias (a tabela guarda só o último voto de cada uma).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Votantes" FROM topgg_votes WHERE "lastVoteAt" > now() - interval '30 days'

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT g) AS "Guildas ativas" FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE t >= now() - interval '7 days' AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')
